app.title: StatusConnect
app.read_only_hint: Your role in this organization can view but not change anything.

google_error.failed: Could not sign in with Google. Please try again.
google_error.email_unverified: Google has not verified this email address. Use an account with a verified email.
google_error.no_account: There is no account for this Google email. Ask an administrator of your organization to add you.
google_error.pending: Your account is awaiting approval or is suspended. You will get an email when it is enabled.
google_error.mismatch: This email is already linked to another Google account. Sign in with email and password or contact support.
google_error.blocked: Your account is blocked. Contact the platform administrators.

dashboard.checks_falling_behind: Warning: Background check execution is lagging behind scheduled wave capacity.

monitors.title: Monitors
monitors.search_placeholder: Search monitors by name or target...
monitors.name: Name
monitors.kind_agent_hint: The agent on your server pushes metrics to StatusConnect. You get an ingestion URL and a ready Telegraf or OpenTelemetry Collector configuration after saving.
monitors.agent_latency_metric_hint: Its value, in ms, becomes each check's response time (a key from Latest metrics). Leave empty for none.
monitors.interval_floor_hint: Your {plan} plan allows intervals of {seconds} seconds or more.
monitors.egress_hint: Controls which hosts this monitor is allowed to reach. "Internal" requires the target host to be pre-allowlisted by an admin.
monitors.check_region_hint: Where the remote probe runs this monitor's HTTP checks.
monitors.confirmation_threshold: Confirmation threshold (failing checks before an incident)
monitors.mqtt_target_hint: mqtt://host:port without TLS (default port 1883) or mqtts://host:port with TLS (default port 8883). The port must be allowed by OUTBOUND_ALLOWED_PORTS.
monitors.mqtt_password_kept: Stored; leave empty to keep it
monitors.mqtt_client_id_hint: Up to 23 letters, digits, _ or -. Empty uses one based on the monitor id.
monitors.mqtt_verify_hint: Turn off only for a broker with a self-signed certificate.

setup.title: Set up StatusConnect
setup.intro: Create the first account. It becomes the platform administrator and owns the first organization and its public status page.
setup.restricted: Only pre-authorized email addresses can complete this setup.
setup.slug_hint: Lowercase letters, numbers and hyphens. Public URL: /status/{slug}
setup.not_required: Setup is already complete. Sign in instead.
setup.link: First time here? Set up StatusConnect

status_page.title: Status page
status_page.none_yet: This environment has no status page yet. Fill in the form to create it.
status_page.components_hint: Each component shows on the public page with the combined state of its monitors.
status_page.no_monitors: No monitors in this environment yet.
status_page.delete_confirm: Delete this component from the status page?
status_page.read_only: Your role is read-only: you can view but not change this page.
status_page.updates_hint: Shown on the public page for 30 days and kept in its update history. Only what you write here is public; internal incident notes are never published.
status_page.update_delete_confirm: Delete this update from the public page?
status_page.branding_hint: Logo, header colour and footer links on the public page.
status_page.logo_hint: PNG, JPG, WebP or GIF up to 1 MB. Shown up to 48 px tall in the header; it replaces the page title there.
status_page.show_powered_by: Show "Status page by StatusConnect" in the footer
status_page.custom_domain_hint: Serve this page on your own hostname. Point a CNAME record at {host} and ask the StatusConnect operator to activate the domain and its SSL certificate.
status_page.subscriptions_hint: Visitors leave their email, confirm with the link and get incident and update notices. Addresses are not shown to anyone.

users.name: Name
users.roles_help: Owners manage everything, including other owners. Admins manage monitors, the status page and admin/viewer members. Viewers can only look. An organization always keeps at least one owner.
users.add_hint: If the email has no account yet, one is created with a temporary password that you hand over yourself (no email is sent).
users.added_existing: {email} already had an account and now has access.
users.temp_password_hint: Send this password to {email} through a private channel. They should change it under Settings after signing in.
users.temp_password_once: This password is shown only now. Closing this dialog hides it for good.
users.platform_only: Only platform admins can open this page.
users.grant_admin_confirm: Give {email} access to every organization as platform admin?
users.reset_confirm: Generate a new temporary password for {email}? The current password stops working.
users.approve_confirm: Approve {name}? The owner gets an email and can sign in.
users.plan_confirm: Move {name} to the {plan} plan? Monitors above the new limit are paused.
users.platform_lead: Actions here apply to every organization on this installation.
users.suspend_confirm: Suspend {name}? Members cannot sign in and monitors stop until you approve it again. Nothing is deleted.

agents.token_once: Copy it now: the token is shown only once. Rotate it to get a new one.
agents.rotate_confirm: Rotate the ingestion token? The agent stops reporting until you update its URL.
agents.waiting: Waiting for the first data from the agent.
agents.waiting_hint: Install Telegraf or the OpenTelemetry Collector on the server, paste the configuration shown after creating or rotating the token, and restart it.
agents.rules_hint: A rule fires when the metric matches the condition. "Down" rules open incidents; "degraded" rules mark the monitor degraded.
agents.no_rules: No rules yet. Without rules the monitor only checks that data keeps arriving.
agents.read_only: Your role can view this monitor but not change it.

plan.title: Plan and billing
plan.subtitle: Limits and subscription of {org}.
plan.no_context: No organization selected. Sign out and back in.
plan.overdue_hint: A payment is overdue. After the grace period the organization goes back to the Free plan and monitors above its limit are paused.
plan.cancel_confirm: Cancel the subscription? The organization goes back to the Free plan.
plan.cancel_confirm_until: Cancel the subscription? The current plan stays until {date}; then the organization goes back to Free.
plan.feature_domain: Custom domain on the status page
plan.billing_off: Online billing is not enabled on this installation. Ask the administrator to change plans.
plan.change_hint: To change plans, cancel the current subscription and subscribe to the new plan.
plan.owner_only: Only organization owners can subscribe to a plan.
plan.checkout_intro: Billing is monthly, through Asaas. You pick Pix, boleto or card on the payment page. The plan changes when the payment is confirmed.
plan.bill_document_hint: Digits, with or without punctuation; used on the charge and the invoice.
plan.invoice_soon: Subscription created. The invoice shows up here in a moment; Asaas also emails it.

statuses.error: Issuing failed, we are on it

trial.after_hint: When the trial ends, the organization moves back to the free plan unless you subscribe. Monitors above the limits are paused; nothing is deleted.
trial.offer_title: Try {plan} free for {days} days, no card
trial.offer_hint: Once per organization. Afterwards it moves back to the free plan unless you subscribe.
trial.owner_only: Only owners and admins can start the trial.
trial.confirm: Start the {days}-day {plan} trial now? It can only be used once.

terms.title: Terms of Use and Privacy
terms.intro: To keep using StatusConnect, read and accept the documents below (in Portuguese).
terms.checkbox: I have read and accept the Terms of Use and the Privacy Policy.

notifications.no_context: No organization or environment selected yet. Sign out and back in.
notifications.name: Name
notifications.test_failed: Could not send the test notification: {error}
notifications.telegram_intro: Open the link in Telegram and press Start. To get alerts in a group, choose "Add to a group" and pick the group. The link works once.
notifications.telegram_qr_hint: Or scan with your phone's camera.
notifications.telegram_waiting: Waiting for Telegram… the link expires in {time}.
notifications.telegram_expired: The link expired before it was used.
notifications.whatsapp_intro: Open the link on the phone that should receive the alerts and send the message as it is. The code works once.
notifications.whatsapp_waiting: Waiting for WhatsApp… the link expires in {time}.
notifications.whatsapp_expired: The link expired before it was used.

checker.title: Checker load
checker.not_measured: Not measured. Run php artisan monitor:capacity-test and set CHECKER_CAPACITY_PER_MINUTE.
checker.last_tick_detail: {at}: {seconds} s, {executed} checked, {deferred} left for the next tick
checker.never: The checker has not run yet.
checker.saturated: Saturated since {since}: {ticks} ticks in a row left monitors for the next minute or ran too long. Checks are running late.
checker.hint: A tick is saturated when it leaves due monitors behind or runs {seconds} s or longer. After {ticks} in a row the platform admins are emailed. See docs/deployment/capacity.md.

admin.add_member_email: Email of an existing or new user
admin.block_confirm: Block {email}? They cannot sign in by password, Google or GrandpaSSOn, their open sessions end and their personal tokens are revoked. Their organizations are not changed.
admin.block_hint: Blocking applies to this person only; the organization's suspension is separate. Ending sessions signs the person out everywhere; they can sign in again.
admin.email_change_confirm: Change the email from {from} to {to}? The new address must be confirmed before the user can sign in again, and the Google link is removed.
admin.email_change_hint: The new address gets a confirmation link and stays unconfirmed until it is opened; the user cannot sign in until then. Sign in with Google is unlinked.
admin.end_sessions_confirm: Sign {email} out of every browser and device? They can sign in again.
admin.new_user_hint: The user gets an email with a link to choose a password; choosing it also confirms the address. The link lasts as long as a password reset link; after that, "Forgot password" sends a new one.
admin.no_orgs: Not a member of any organization.
admin.slug_change_confirm: Change the status page address from /status/{from} to /status/{to}? Links to the old address keep working with a permanent redirect, but update them where you can.
admin.slug_change_hint: Changing the address moves the public status page from /status/{from}. The old address redirects to the new one.
admin.transfer_confirm: Make {name} the only owner of {org}? The other owners become admins.
admin.unblock_confirm: Unblock {email}? They can sign in again.
admin.user_created: User {email} created; the password email was sent.
